lanes.queue_slot: Tuesday's queue (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 2.6), through serial_dispatch.sh only. Read-only DB load; free; ~20-35 min job time.
lanes.embedding: allowed before the read (section 2.7: 'c19 / c20 embed, inside the regenerated ids scope, or blocks'); an embed is not a read. c20's listing ids must be inside the embed's scope and the heads dump's listing_ids_file if the reference reads heads (section 'heads').

heads.when: Only if the reference, or MF, reads image_tags=heads (R1 shipped with heads). The c20 export is made on main before R1 merges, so its images carry no head record, and `harness run` refuses image_tags=heads on such a file.
heads.procedure: As in cohort 19's file (section 'heads'), with c20 in place of c19. The dump of record is the latest `tag_model.yml stage=dump` completed before MF's freeze addendum whose probe.json names the head model active at the freeze and whose listing_ids_file holds every c20 listing id. The attach step is: PYTHONPATH=<worktree at the reference's sha> python3 /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/preregistrations/attach_heads.py <c20 cohort.jsonl.gz> /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/preregistrations/c20_heads_dump_<DUMP_RUN_ID> /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/preregistrations/c20_heads.jsonl.gz (attach_heads.py sha256 5d194f30f36abe4553cef046fdb285f8d058aaa7003df7cdbcbf42282ff708af). REF and MF then both read c20_heads.jsonl.gz.
heads.coverage_rule: At most 1 % of c20's images uncarried: the runs go ahead, with the uncarried count and listing ids in the freeze addendum, and the reference's run.json image_tags.unscored must equal the report's uncarried. Above 1 %: there is no fallback, because the reference is the live engine, so the freeze waits for an embed of the uncarried listings and a fresh dump, judged by the same rule. A dump row naming no engine room: NOT-MEASURABLE until a clean dump exists.

read_protocol.frames: M4 frame = the groups MF forms that REF does not (a group of >= 2 adverts whose member set is not a REF group). M5 frame = the REF groups MF breaks up (autodedup/lab/page.py `splits`; an absorbed REF group is asked about through the MF group). Groups holding a flagged advert are left out of both frames. seal_draw.py (sha256 298ef8d1916087cb8672913e17961348153b3ec07f03058059f0deb6904ed6ee) computes the frames, the draw and the screen, and governs over any other tool.
read_protocol.draw: each frame sorted by its sorted member-id tuple, then random.Random(20260928).shuffle(frame), separately per frame with a fresh generator; the first 40 of each are drawn (all if fewer). seal_draw.py writes them to c20_reads/draw.json before any page is built.
read_protocol.screen: WAVES.md:87, as on cohort 19. Every M4 group not drawn is screened by C7's fused-shape screen (two members of one portal co-live for more than a day; two priced members whose price paths do not agree at 0.005) plus the same-broker limb for sequential siblings. Every flagged group is HAND-READ; the rest are listed (count and member ids) in draw.json.
read_protocol.page: One private review page (B-i) per frame. The M4 page holds the 40 drawn cards, then every hand-read card; the M5 page holds 40 cards. This is the c20 part of RP4: about 35 minutes for 80 cards at ~25 s a card, plus ~25 s per hand-read card, with no cap; MF's go / no-go waits for the last card. Each card shows every member's portal link, stated facts and decided pairs. It says neither which arm formed the group nor whether the card was drawn or hand-read.
read_protocol.verdict: binary: 'One property' or 'Not one property'. A card left unanswered counts AGAINST MF: as fused in M4 (drawn or hand-read), as one property (a true group MF lost) in M5.
read_protocol.classification_D7: Pre-registered (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 2.2, decision D7): a group is FUSED when any two members state a different value of any fact (area, floor or its wording, disposition, price while co-live, part of town, room size in the body, unit designator, cellar or accessory, ...), UNLESS an operator ruling covers the pair, or an operator ruling on a convention covers the difference (identical units are one property; a floor-numbering convention). 'Inside the engine's tolerance' is not an excuse. Undecidable counts against the arm. Standing rulings apply: a rental is never one property with a sale; a flat is never one property with a commercial unit; image tags are never facts. The operator reads; the operator's read is final, and a 'One property' read against a stated difference is recorded with that difference.
read_protocol.wilson: The shares of the DRAWN cards are reported with the 95 % Wilson interval; 0 of 40 bounds the fused share at <= 8.8 %. Hand-read cards are reported as counts.

bars.A4: M4 on c20 with the production model file: 0 fused under D7 among the drawn MF-only groups AND among the hand-read ones (the screen's flags and every same-broker group), with undecidable counting as fused (section 2.5).
bars.A5: M4 vs M5 on c20, on the DRAWN cards: MF-only's one-property Wilson lower bound >= REF-only's (the M5 draw's one-property share, read as REF's own-group precision), AND estimated true groups gained > lost, i.e. (MF-only groups x M4 one-property share) > (REF-only groups x M5 one-property share).
bars.A3: every fixture pair of the extended list (section 2.1) that lives in c20 kept apart; expected vacuous (the fixtures live in trial, c17, c18 and c6).
bars.readouts: computed once at the same opening, never bars on c20: M7, M9 (decide wall MF / REF), certain-duplicate recall (truth16.py) MF vs REF, re-post trains newly split. A6 stays descriptive (D11).
bars.not_computable_here: A1 and A2 (no operator rulings on c20), A7, A8, A9 (trial / c17 / c18 by definition).

refusal_rule: A4 failing (>= 1 fused MF-only group, drawn or hand-read, or an unanswered card) or A5 failing REFUSES MF on this ground: MF does not ship as R2 in this cycle unless a fresh sealed cohort is cut and passes. A4's fused cards are read for their stated fact; a fix is a reader or tolerance counted against stop rule (b), and per 'second_read' it confirms on a fresh cohort, never on c20. A5 failing buys more labels only under stop rule (c).
verdict_forms: PASS (A4 and A5 pass, A3 holds), REFUSE (A4 or A5 fails, with the cards), VOID (post_export_checks flag > 1 %), NOT-MEASURABLE (a run, the production model file or the freeze addendum is missing; the heads coverage rule is not met; or the dump names no engine room).
